other_failure_modes.name: Destructive categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent coerces categorical/object columns to numeric using errors='coerce', which replaces all non-numeric string values with NaNs, effectively destroying any non-numeric categorical information.

summary: The agent correctly frames the task and sets up a cross-validation loop to train an ensemble of gradient boosting models. However, it fails to evaluate the models on the validation folds, providing no insight into model performance. Additionally, there is moderate data leakage from imputing missing values before the CV splits, an absence of feature engineering, and the ensemble relies on a naive unweighted average.
